'''February 2001 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Video Connection, Framingham, MA on 3 February 2001. [[Michael Schiemer]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1700">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-framingham-ma-2-3-01d1700/ framingham-ma-2-3-01], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 4 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-framingham-ma-2-3-01d1700/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Video Connection, Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 31
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Schiemer]]
